description: Ask to publish one of a person's own spaces, as their agent (OpenVibe.Actor) built it (plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). POST /api/v1/spaces/:id/publish asks and answers { state: 'pending' } with the request the person answers in the Dock; Space never publishes without that answer, and the agent is told to wait. The person's answer reaches Space through POST /api/v1/agent/approvals/:id/decide.
